claims.claim: All existing specs touching these three inputs use happy-dom and assert only individual properties (tagName, type, value, placeholder, disabled, aria-label text, presence/absence) — none enumerate a closed/exhaustive attribute set, so none would break from adding a `list` attribute

Grep for `getAttributeNames|outerHTML|toMatchInlineSnapshot|toMatchSnapshot|\.attributes\b` across all three files returned zero hits.

risks: The event-DETAIL route (event/[id]) genuinely has no multi-location corpus in memory — implementing datalist there per the issue's 'NO new fetch' constraint yields a near-useless 1-2-value list (current value + series default). This needs an explicit PO scope call: (a) skip the datalist on event-edit-input-location entirely, (b) ship it anyway with the trivial 0-2-value set, or (c) accept a new fetch there (which contradicts the issue's stated constraint). Flagging per the issue's own instruction.

event-create-location (root +page.svelte) never received #239's visible-<span>-label treatment — it still relies on aria-label only. Not a datalist blocker, but worth noting if PO wants label consistency addressed in the same pass.

Line numbers in the issue body (6176/7249/1950) are stale by a handful of lines vs current main (now ~6190-6201/7272-7281/2009-2020) due to intervening #238/#239/#240/#241 commits; current-tree line numbers are reported above.

Summary for the parent agent:
1. Three input sites confirmed at (main, current line numbers): series-create-location +page.svelte:6192-6201 (labeled), event-create-location +page.svelte:7272-7281 (aria-label only), event-edit-input-location event/[id]/+page.svelte:2010-2020 (inline pencil-edit, aria-label only). None carry a `list` attribute today.
2. THE GAP is real: event/[id] route has no AgendaItem[]/location corpus in memory — loadEventDetail (src/lib/events/eventDetail.ts) fetches only the single event's own `location` plus its parent series' `default_location` as a fallback string, never a list. Cheapest no-new-fetch source there is at most 2 trivial values (current value + series default) — recommend flagging to PO whether to skip datalist on that field or accept it's a near-empty list, rather than fetching more data.
3. On the agenda page (root +page.svelte), `agendaItems`/`recentItems` ($state<AgendaItem[]>, :143/:191) are already loaded at page load and live in the exact same component scope as seriesCreateLocation/eventCreateLocation — a datalist sourced from `[...agendaItems, ...recentItems].map(i => i.location)` needs zero prop-drilling on the two create forms.
4. Zero `datalist` precedent in the codebase (repo-wide grep, both main and worktree). happy-dom (the project's DOM test env for these specs) handles `list` attr + `<option>` querying fine — verified live with a throwaway vitest probe, no environment limitation.
5. No existing spec on these three inputs asserts a closed/exhaustive attribute set — all check individual props/attrs (tagName, type, value, placeholder, disabled, aria-label, presence). Adding `list=` to any of the three inputs will not break any currently-passing assertion.
